title: recommend-fixtures
description: Recorded walks of the decision trees: an input situation and the recommendation it must produce. Together they reach all 48 leaves, which is what makes the corpus a coverage claim rather than a sample.

trees_yaml_sha256.description: Pins this corpus to the exact trees it was walked against. A corpus replayed against different trees proves nothing about either.

input.description: Usually the measured data properties as an object, but two fixtures carry a bare string and one a list. Those are deliberate hostile inputs -- the recommender must survive being handed the wrong shape -- so this is permissive by measurement, not by omission.

output.description: Deliberately open beyond `status`. The nine observed key sets differ by status (a recommendation carries card_id and tool_fns; a need_data_property carries the missing property and the question to ask), and pinning every combination here would encode the recommender's control flow in a shape contract, where it does not belong. `status` is the field every consumer switches on, so that one is closed.

tool_fns.description: Carried through from the tree leaf, so it inherits the same scalar-or-list shape: a single tool is a bare string, a pipeline is a list, and an empty list is the guard leaf that recommends nothing.
